references.text: Repeats the principle that the inheritance shall not pass from one tribe to another, and confirms that each tribe shall retain its inheritance.
The background for the inheritance law given to Zelophehad's daughters, which led to the need for this additional provision to preserve the tribes' inheritance.
The fulfillment of the inheritance law for Zelophehad's daughters when the land was distributed under Joshua.
The laws concerning the Year of Jubilee that protect the tribes' inheritance and ensure that land remains within families and tribes.
The inheritance shall be distributed by tribe through casting lots, and each tribe shall retain its allotted portion.
The prince shall not take from the people's inheritance; he shall give his sons an inheritance from his own property, so that my people will not be scattered from their possession.
Jacob's blessing over the twelve tribes establishes the foundation for the tribal divisions and their respective inherited lands.
